Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening. response:
You're sitting on the couch, playing video games, when your 12-year-old sister Lily bursts into the room, a mischievous grin spreading across her face.

"Rai, I need your help!" she exclaims, plopping down beside you on the couch. "I'm going to be babysitting for Grandma tonight, and I want to make sure I'm ready. But I need your help to practice."

You look up at her, skeptical. "What do you need me to do?"

Lily's grin widens. "I want you to help me train in babysitting. But I have a special plan. I want to regress you back in age to a 6-year-old so I can babysit you for the evening."

You raise an eyebrow, unsure of what to make of this request. "You want to turn me into a 6-year-old? Why?"

Lily shrugs. "It'll be fun, I promise! And it'll be good practice for me to babysit a 6-year-old. Plus, I get to be the big sister and take care of you."

You're not sure if you're comfortable with this idea, but Lily's enthusiasm is infectious. You start to wonder if it might actually be kind of cool to be a 6-year-old again.

Do you:
    - Agree to let Lily regress you back in age
    - Refuse to let Lily regress you back in age
    - Ask Lily more questions about what this regression process will entail

What will you say?
